text: 此刻把阿米莉娅独自留下，风险太大。你决定把她绑起来。你从入口处的一些家具上扯下一块防尘布，用它把她绑在房间里的扶手椅上。她挣扎了一会儿，但在心烦意乱的状态下很快放弃抵抗，安静下来。
你刚把绳结系牢，房子的前门便砰地打开，门扇在铰链上剧烈摇晃。约书亚堵在门口，脸涨得通红，怒不可遏。他右手拿着枪，迅速举枪对准你。
你只有一瞬间可以扑倒在地，之后他就会扣下扳机。也许你的反应够快。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 125
text: Amelia is too much of a liability to leave alone at the present moment. You resolve to restrain her. You pull a dust sheet off some of the furniture in the entryway and use it to bind her to an armchair in the room. She struggles for a moment, but in her distraught state, she quickly sinks into resignation and ceases to resist.

As you finish securing the knots, the front door of the house flies open, rattling on its hinges. Dominating the doorway is Joshua, red-faced and furious. He has a gun in his right hand, which he quickly aims in your direction.
You have just a second to hit the ground before he pulls the trigger. Perhaps your reflexes are quick enough.
